verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Tempe, Arizona, just steps from Arizona State University.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel in the heart of Tempe, Arizona, just steps from Arizona State University.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Camelback Mountain, ASU Stadium and the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: offers stunning views of Camelback Mountain, ASU Stadium,...See More and the city from guest rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: Rooms have spa-centric bathrooms with rain showers and the Westin Heavenly Bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: spa-centric bathrooms complete with rain showers. Enjoy a restful night's sleep on our signature Westin Heavenly Bed.

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the mountain skyline, a living and entertainment space, a wet bar, a separate king bedroom and a deep soaking garden tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Penthouse Suite features stunning floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the incredible mountain skyline, a spacious living and entertainment space, a wet bar, a separate master king bedroom, and a bathroom featuring a deep soaking garden tub.

verified_facts.text: Upgraded deluxe rooms and suites include corner rooms with views of Camelback and A Mountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: our upgraded deluxe guest rooms and suites that feature incredible views of Camelback and "A" Mountain.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has daybeds, lounge chairs and a hot tub, with views of downtown, Camelback Mountain and ASU Stadium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax and unwind at our rooftop pool, featuring daybeds, lounge chairs, and a hot tub. Enjoy stunning views of downtown, Camelback Mountain, and ASU Stadium

verified_facts.text: Private shaded rooftop cabanas can be rented, each with two chaise lounges, bottled water and food and drink service from Skysill.
verified_facts.excerpt: Upgrade your rooftop escape with a private shaded cabana, perfect for soaking up the sun in comfort. Ideal for couples or small groups, each rental includes two chaise lounges, refreshing bottled water, and exclusive food & drink service from Skysill Rooftop Bar.

verified_facts.text: Skysill Rooftop Lounge is described as the highest rooftop bar in Tempe, with sweeping city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in sweeping city views from the highest rooftop bar in Tempe.

verified_facts.text: Terra Tempe Kitchen and Spirits serves a revolving menu of Sonoran dishes from seasonal ingredients sourced through local farmers and artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our revolving menu of Sonoran dishes is rooted in seasonal ingredients from our own backyard.

verified_facts.text: The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24 hours and has Peloton bikes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Maintain your fitness routine in our 24-hour WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio, equipped with state-of-the-art equipment, including Peloton bikes.

verified_facts.text: Guests get complimentary bike rentals for two hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the city in style with our complimentary bike rentals! Enjoy two hours of cycling adventure on us.

verified_facts.text: The Mill Avenue District is a 5-minute walk and A Mountain (Hayden Butte) an 8-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Mill Avenue District – 0.2 miles (5-minute walk) \| Tempe Town Lake – 0.7 miles (15-minute walk) \|
"A" Mountain (Hayden Butte) – 0.4 miles (8-minute walk)

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts events such as rooftop DJ nights, seasonal pop-ups, wellness experiences and culinary events.
verified_facts.excerpt: From rooftop DJ nights and seasonal pop-ups to wellness experiences and culinary events

verified_facts.text: The hotel is cashless; it accepts major credit cards and mobile payments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that The Westin Tempe is a cashless hotel. We accept all major credit cards and mobile payment methods; cash is not accepted.
